{{Top|leg}}
'''Prayer''' was a religious ritual in which living beings spoke, sang, or thought messages to one or more [[God/Legends|deities]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] said his first prayer while the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was escaping the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. [[Dornean/Legends|Dorneans]], [[Blood Carver]]s, the [[Order of the Sacred Circle]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], and the [[Nuns of G'aav'aar'oon]] regularly prayed.
